name: paper_nc_cc_inductorless
description: Miniature wide-band noise-canceling inductorless CMOS LNA in a current-conveyor (CC) arrangement. M1 is the common-gate input device: because the input signal enters its source, the input transistor's thermal noise appears in anti-phase at its drain (DN) and source (SN) nodes. M2 is a source-follower that completes the current conveyor. Two inverting common-source noise-cancel paths (MX sensing the SN node, MY sensing the DN node) sum at the output node so that the input device's noise cancels while the signal adds; MF is a feedback device and RY the output load. The M3..M13 bank is the mirror/current-source biasing that sets the branch currents. Inductorless by design. Cited paper transcription -- topology + full Table-1 W/L set transcribed, no value invented.
source_family: Inductorless wideband noise-canceling current-conveyor CMOS LNA (common-gate input device with two summed inverting noise-cancel paths)

cited_paper.title: Miniature Wide-Band Noise-Canceling CMOS LNA
cited_paper.open_access: yes -- Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY), confirmed retrievable at the URL above
cited_paper.what_was_actually_read: The article HTML was fetched (WebFetch). The current-conveyor + noise-cancel mechanism description and the full Table-1 W/L set were read from the text. The paper's own schematic figure was not machine-readable via the available tools; the exact node-level wiring of the M3..M13 mirror bank is therefore reconstructed by convention (see ambiguous_or_uncertain).

published_values_table1.note: W/L values transcribed verbatim from Table 1. AnalogGenie is topology-only: the token sequence carries no magnitudes, so these values live only here in provenance and are NOT injected into the netlist. Every value above is paper-sourced; none is invented.

Validated through the same pipeline: upstream build_connection_matrix/dfs_all_paths (execed read-only from AnalogGenie/repo) -> Graph csv -> Eulerian token sequence -> lna/topology.py structural screen. No external SPICE was parsed.
device_map: Cin (VIN1 SN) capacitor  -- input DC block into the common-gate source node
M1 (DN VB1 SN VSS) nmos4 -- common-gate input device; D=DN, G=VB1(bias), S=SN(input), B=VSS
M2 (VDD DN SN VSS) nmos4 -- source-follower completing the current conveyor; senses DN, drives SN
MX (VOUT1 SN VSS VSS) nmos4 -- inverting CS noise-cancel path sensing the source node SN
MY (VOUT1 DN VSS VSS) nmos4 -- inverting CS noise-cancel path sensing the drain node DN, summed at VOUT1
MF (DN VOUT1 SN VSS) nmos4  -- feedback device around the input node
RY (VOUT1 VDD) resistor     -- output load, 220 ohm
M3..M13 (mirror bank) nmos4 -- current-source / mirror biasing of the branches; the eleven 2x0.5um devices

transcription_confidence: HIGH for the family and its defining mechanism (common-gate input device whose drain/source noise is summed and canceled through two inverting paths MX/MY at a shared output load RY -- read directly from the paper text) and for all Table-1 W/L magnitudes (transcribed verbatim). MEDIUM for the exact node-level wiring of the M3..M13 mirror/current-source bank, which the fetched text does not specify device-by-device; the canonical current-mirror biasing (diode-referenced NMOS sources to the branch nodes, referenced to VBX/VBF/VB1) is used, following the standard implementation of this technique, rather than being read off the figure.
ambiguous_or_uncertain: Exact node-by-node connectivity of M3..M13 (the eleven 2x0.5um mirror devices): the fetched text gives their sizes but not a per-device netlist. Canonical current-mirror biasing was used; flagged rather than invented as a specific published wiring.
Whether MF's gate senses the output (VOUT1) or an internal node: 'feedback device' was described but the exact sensed node was not; the output-referenced convention was used.
No W/L is injected into the topology (AnalogGenie is value-free); the Table-1 W/L set is recorded above for provenance only.
excluded_paper_check: Independent of, and unrelated to, the Kanchetla et al. TMTT 2022 paper this pipeline is blind-reproducing. This is an inductorless wideband noise-canceling current-conveyor CMOS LNA (broadband, inductorless family); it does not derive from and nor references the excluded GNSS narrowband inductively-matched CMOS design. The fetched article contains no mention of Kanchetla, NavIC, or BeiDou.
